title: Paving patterns with attractor colouring
summary: Lays out rectangular pavers with joints, shifts every second course to make a running bond, and colours the pavers randomly or by distance to an attractor curve - a toolkit for hardscape and floor patterns.
how_to_use: 'Paver X' and 'Paver Y' set the paver size, 'Paver height' the thickness, 'Joint' the gap between pavers.
'Area X' and 'Area Y' set how many pavers in each direction.
'Bond shift ratio' (the panel, default 2) shifts alternate courses by Paver X / ratio for a running bond.
Right-click 'Attractor curve' and Set one Curve to colour by distance from a path; 'Sample distance' samples it, 'Contrast' scales the effect.
Change 'Colour seed' and 'Attractor seed' for different random colourings. Bake the Box parameters to keep the pavers.
concepts: Domain Box: a paver from a corner point and size domains
Dispatch: splitting a list into alternating items for running bond
Closest Point + Remap: attractor colouring along a curve

steps.title: 1  INPUTS - change these
steps.explain: Paver size and joint, area, bond shift, the attractor curve and the two random seeds.

steps.title: 2  Stacked bond: grid of pavers
steps.explain: A Rectangular grid gives one corner point per paver. Domain Box builds each paver from its corner, with the joint subtracted from its length and width. This is a stacked bond: every course lines up.

steps.title: 3  Running bond: shift every second course
steps.explain: Dispatch splits the pavers into alternating courses. One set is moved along X by Paver X / Bond shift ratio, then both sets are merged back - a running bond.

steps.title: 4  RESULT - random and attractor colours
steps.explain: Random + Gradient gives every paver a random colour. Closest Point measures each paver's distance to the attractor curve; Remap, a random factor and Contrast turn that into a second Gradient. The two Custom Previews show both colourings.
